the causal propagation functions for a Dirac field are split into two functions which satisfy integral equations similar to a system of two Low equations for a symmetrical charged fixed source meson theory in the one-mesone approximation.

the causal propagation functions for the Dirac field can, in the one meson approximation, be expressed as the sum of two functions which satisfy the same system of integral equations as in the Low theory for the symmetrical fixed-source charged meson theory in the one-mesonic approximation.
